BiblicalUsage: Acharein means last, at the last, in the end. It occurs once, in Daniel 4:8, where at the last Daniel comes in before Nebuchadnezzar to hear the dream, the one in whom is the spirit of the holy gods.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Daniel comes last and still stands first, because the wisdom of God outlasts every wise man in Babylon.
